dimensions.note: Requests explicitly exclude credentials and raw evidence; output summary rejects secret-like content.
Methods have no entry or completion logging.
Bindings and policy are validated before result writes; staged writes have explicit resumable states.
Tests cover duplicate gating, failure bounds, minimization, policy rejection, and replay after each staged-write failure.
Request/result staged writes resume safely and completed exact result replay emits no handles.
No provider or network API is invoked by the extension.
Workspace is constrained to /tmp and execution remains external-only.
Fixtures use synthetic provider, model, incident, and evidence identifiers.
Lifecycle, request, result, audit, and method contracts are strict and bounded.
All three resources declare explicit lifetime and garbage collection.
Purpose-built gated state machine rather than a CRUD resource lifecycle.
No infrastructure mutation; typed policy and lifecycle gates precede persistence.
lifecycle-, request-, and result-prefixed names are spec-specific and collision-safe.
Stored lifecycle, request, and result state is read through context.readResource.
Initial standalone publication; no prior published model version.
